Three Youths Die in Car Crash in Kaithal

Three young men died when their car crashed into a tree in Kaithal, Haryana. The vehicle was reportedly out of control and was reduced to wreckage. Rescue workers had to cut through windows to retrieve the bodies. Two of the deceased were the great-grandsons of a former MLA.
